verdict: M169/M170 establish a correct 2.498284208x cross-artifact logic-area-normalized arithmetic-island boundary under the frozen M168 bank-service model. They do not establish a complete-FC2, physical, energy, FFN, or system speedup.

P0.finding: The exact M168 schedule requires an event compactor plus eight persistent per-bank queues; neither M169 nor M170 implements or cycle-charges them.
P0.exit_gate: Execute the frozen payload schedule through a cycle-accurate compactor/queue model with finite depths, stalls, tags and no event loss.

P0.finding: K4 assumes four simultaneous 96-byte signed-weight rows, or 3072 bits/cycle. Both DC runs have zero SRAM macros and ZeroWireload, so the dominant bandwidth, banking, response-tag and routed-port cost is absent.
P0.exit_gate: Provide a four-bank macro organization with CACTI/compiler or foundry macro evidence, response timing and macro-inclusive area/power.

P0.finding: The 2304-bit accumulator context is externally supplied and returned every issue. There is no context store, same-token K4 recurrence, arbitration or writeback, and no exact 120-payload RTL replay.
P0.exit_gate: Integrate a bounded context owner and replay all frozen FC2 events to a software golden result with exact ordering and overflow proof.

P0.finding: Multiplier-free event-to-weight identity is checkpoint-specific: all frozen ep35 sn2 thresholds equal one. PAFT admission and valid825 are not present.
P0.exit_gate: Prove the released PAFT checkpoint preserves the threshold-one/folded-weight contract and passes valid825, or regenerate the numeric bridge.

P1.finding: The K4/K1 DC comparison is fair only at standalone logic-island scope. M169 exposes 8152 ports versus M170's 5548, while ZeroWireload assigns no routed penalty to the 2604-port delta.
P1.exit_gate: Repeat the matched comparison after wrapping identical realistic SRAM/context interfaces and routed interconnect.

P1.finding: No SAIF/PTPX or macro energy result supports an energy-efficiency claim; accepted_weight_active_mask marks enabled rows, not actual weight-bit switching.
P1.exit_gate: Capture representative SAIF from exact-payload replay and run macro-inclusive PTPX.

P1.finding: No RTL-to-netlist Formality result is sealed for M169/M170.
P1.exit_gate: Run exact-SHA Formality for both matched controls.

P1.finding: The island stops before FC2 requantization, BN2 folding and residual commit, so the 3.875660x bank-service reduction cannot yet be promoted to FC2 cycles.
P1.exit_gate: Compose the island with final quantization/BN2/residual timing and report end-to-end FC2 cycles.

P1.finding: The reported 2.498284208x divides evidence from two separately sealed artifacts rather than measuring one executable integrated configuration.
P1.exit_gate: Seal a single composition receipt that binds payload schedule, K4 RTL, K1 control, context/memory wrappers and cycle counters.

P2.finding: DC emits VER-318 signed-to-unsigned part-select warnings at the explicit truncation assignment in both designs.
P2.exit_gate: Use an explicit signed cast or document and lint-waive the bit-preserving truncation.

P2.finding: Directed VCS does not exhaustively cover signed INT8 extremes, all legal distinct-bank combinations, or every duplicate-bank pair.
P2.exit_gate: Add boundary vectors for -128/127 and constrained exhaustive legality cases.

P2.finding: The stale M170 r1 DC directory is correctly marked FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE, but downstream collectors must select only sealed r1b.
P2.exit_gate: Keep an explicit deny-list or latest-sealed manifest so r1 cannot be cited accidentally.

permitted_wording: On the frozen ten-sample H67 FC2 payloads, K4 reduces exact modulo-8 bank-service cycles by 3.875660x versus K1. In matched 3ns TSMC-28 logic-only DC, the standalone K4 arithmetic island costs 1.551329x the K1 cell area, yielding a 2.498284x logic-area-normalized arithmetic-island boundary. Compaction, SRAM macros, accumulator-context storage, BN2/residual, routing and power are excluded.
forbidden_wording: paper-ready PPA, FPS or energy efficiency
recommended_next_milestone: Build a minimal executable K4 FC2 shell: finite eight-bank compactor queues, four weight-bank response ports, one bounded accumulator-context slot, and end-of-block commit. Compare it against an otherwise identical K1 shell on the exact M168 payloads, then run VCS, matched macro-aware DC/PTPX and Formality.
